entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the AeroPro Helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?
There's no issue, really. I bought it as a potential gift, but the color wasn't quite right for the person. The box is still unopened and everything is in perfect condition.
Okay, I understand. So just to confirm, it's not a technical fault or a safety concern with the helmet, just a preference regarding the color?
That's correct. It's a fantastic helmet, just not the shade I was hoping for.

No problem at all. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 68 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I've had this for a bit and will be paying to ship it back, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order a different item this week.

I understand your request, but unfortunately, I'm not able to offer a discount code in this situation. However, I can confirm we will cover the return shipping for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Oh, free return shipping works for me. That's fair. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
